programs.description: The honest son of a vegetable vendor finds himself embroiled in a world of deceit and manipulation when he falls in love with the daughter of a police commissioner.
A French businessman crosses paths with an Indian autorickshaw driver in the city of Bengaluru. Together, they set out on a twisted journey through the city.
An NRI seeks the help of a television crew to sell his haunted ancestral property. However, the daughter of a wealthy man gets kidnapped and is held hostage in the same bungalow.
Renuka Devi falls for a sage named Jamadagni and gets married to him, leaving all the worldly possessions. Years later, when she daydreams of a materialistic life, the sage curses her.
Narayana attempts to solve the mystery behind the treasure that has gone missing. However, Jayaram, a gang leader, places several obstacles in his way.
An aspiring journalist is recruited by a popular newspaper to write weekly articles aimed at inspiring college students.
Two brothers live in harmony. However, their relationship soon begins to fall apart when the younger brother's wife starts creating clashes between them.
Reeling from a sad breakup, a college student gives up on his studies to commit financial fraud. However, his new endeavour puts him in a difficult spot.
Rajashekhar has two sons, Surya and Kiran, but Surya is adopted. Surya is very hardworking and makes many sacrifices for the family, thereby inciting jealousy in his brother Kiran's heart.

A wealthy couple abandons their infant daughter in their quest to beget a son. However, a shocking revelation awaits them after their son abandons them in their twilight years.
Nandini, a young doctor, falls in love with Jessie, a happy-go-lucky man. But when Nandini gets married to Shyam Prasad at her parents' insistence, Jessie comes back in her life as a ghost.
Kaumasura, a demon, persistently troubles Kola Maharishi during his meditation. When Kola Maharishi prays to Goddess Parvati for deliverance, she incarnates as Mookambika to vanquish the demon.
Siddappa, a cruel landlord, refuses to pay the funeral expenses of his servant after his accidental death. Angered by the betrayal, the worker's son, Veerabhadra, grows up to resent Siddappa.
Three brothers, Shiva, Raghu and Shankar, dote on their sister, Swati, and strive for her happiness. Problems arise when Swati gets married to a cunning, rich man who has ulterior motives.
Newly promoted DCP Agni faces off against a ruthless crime matriarch. When her retaliation claims his family and partner, Agni embarks on a relentless quest for justice.
A genius mathematician uses his skills to assassinate his targets and stay clear of law enforcement. However, a vigilante secretly tracks his movements, vying for revenge.
A young man struggles to pay off his father's debts and decides to visit his family's abandoned bungalow. However, he soon realises that it is haunted by a vengeful ghost.

Murali saves Lakshmi from an abusive marriage and shelters her at his house. However, all hell breaks loose when Murali's girlfriend finds out about their living situation.
After an untimely death, Suri encounters Yama and Chitragupta, sparking a series of hilarious events as he attempts to navigate the complexities of the afterlife.
Angala Parameswari, an avatar of Goddess Parvati, wants to protect the people of Earth. Kaveri, her ardent follower, seeks her help when her life is in danger.
Shankar is an autorickshaw driver belonging to a middle-class family who gets into a conflict with Maya, a moneylender. However, tables turn when she loses her property, and they fall in love.
Madhumati ventures into the Nallamala Forest to procure an ancient book written by priests. Later, she encounters a shape-shifting snake that intends to kill her.
A police officer struggling with a personal loss, has to put aside his feelings and concentrate on the probing of a girl who goes missing.
Ramanuja Iyengari and his gang are determined to get Musthafa expelled from their college. So, after a hilarious series of failed attempts, a riveting cricket match decides their fate.
An intelligent and ambitious youngster arrives in Mumbai and becomes a mafia don, but one day, things take turn when he falls in love with a cop's daughter.

When forest officer Kumar protects natural resources from poachers, their boss, Anand, becomes his main rival. But little does Kumar know that Anand is his brother.
Ananthu, a lawyer from a traditional Brahmin family, falls for Nusrath, a judge from a different faith, leading to a heartfelt journey of love, family expectations and courtroom drama.
Goddess Sigandooru Chowdeshwari rescues her sincere devotees who are stuck in dire circumstances and sincerely seek her divine protection.
A lovelorn village boy, Krishna, and a girl, Kanaka, cross all barriers of caste and tradition to unite in a meaningful manner.
An old couple sacrifices everything, so their children live a happy life. However, they are forced to separate and subjected to ill-treatment and disrespect in their children's homes.
Surya, an orphan raised by the best friend of his deceased mother, wants to become a soldier. He falls in love with a woman but soon gets an offer to join the army.
A mischievous Hanuman grows up to become a heroic being who fights all evil creatures and helps Lord Rama in rescuing Sita from Lanka.
Two thieves take on an audacious task to acquire an antique emerald medallion. In their pursuit, they seek the help of a priest to protect them from an ancient curse.
